history.title: Database issues.
history.body: We are experiencing some issues with our server's database. Please stand by, we will try to fix this as soon as possible.

comments.body: Problem solved, everything's back to normal.

history.title: Maintenance
history.body:
We are going to perform maintenance on all our websites.

Please be advised that all requests may take longer to process.

Email support responses to your inquiries will be delayed.

The websites may run slower than usual or become temporarily inaccessible.

We apologize for the inconvenience and will keep you updated on all tasks at:
https://monitor.aerofinancialfse.com/

comments.body: Almost there, but I need a machine reboot. Everything's going to go down.
Completed with no errors. Sorry for the inconvenience.

info_active.title: Maintenance on September 30, 2026
info_active.body: Our server provider has informed us that they will be performing maintenance on September 30, 2026, from 6:00 AM UTC to 2:00 PM UTC. There may be some server instability during this time.

info_history.title: We need to transfer our domain, aerofinancialfse.com, to a new hosting provider.
info_history.body:
Starting on September 22, 2026, the website may experience some downtime over the next few days. This will affect access to financing, ferry services, and emails.

Don't worry! If you are unable to submit requests or payment renewals during this time, we will process everything manually once the site is back online.

comments.body: We are out of danger (for the moment); we are on the new provider and everything is working correctly. The task is not closed yet and we will investigate tomorrow if everything is running smoothly.
Looks like everything is working fine with no issues.
